name: Sant Cebrià de Vallalta (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow triangle rising from the lower edge to the centre, charged with a white bishop's mitre with yellow bands.
history: Municipal flag of Sant Cebrià de Vallalta; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
